messages.content: 請告訴我美國的一些主要機場。

function.name: distance_calculate
function.description: Calculate the distance between two geographical points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

from_lat.description: The latitude of the start point. This is a float type value.

from_long.description: The longitude of the start point. This is a float type value.

to_lat.description: The latitude of the end point. This is a float type value.

to_long.description: The longitude of the end point. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit for distance calculation, 'miles' or 'kilometers'. Default is 'miles'.

message.content:
以下是美國一些主要的國際與國內機場，按城市或航空樞紐排序：

| 城市 | 機場名稱（英文） | IATA/ICAO 代碼 |
|------|------------------|---------------|
| 紐約 | John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | JFK / KJFK |
| 紐約 | LaGuardia Airport (LGA) | LGA / KLGA |
| 洛杉磯 | Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | LAX / KLAX |
| 芝加哥 | O'Hare International Airport (ORD) | ORD / KORD |
| 舊金山 | San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | SFO / KSFO |
| 西雅圖 | Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | SEA / KSEA |
| 華盛頓特區 | Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) | IAD / KIAD |
| 華盛頓特區 | Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA) | DCA / KDCA |
| 邁阿密 | Miami International Airport (MIA) | MIA / KMIA |
| 拉斯維加斯 | McCarran International Airport (LAS) | LAS / KLAS |
| 波士頓 | Logan International Airport (BOS) | BOS / KBOS |
| 聖地牙哥 | San Diego International Airport (SAN) | SAN / KSAN |
| 奧蘭多 | Orlando International Airport (MCO) | MCO / KMCO |
| 丹佛 | Denver International Airport (DEN) | DEN / KDEN |
| 休斯敦 | George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) | IAH / KIAH |
| 亞特蘭大 | Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | ATL / KATL |
| 亞利桑那州 | Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | PHX / KPHT |
| 亞利桑那州 | Tucson International Airport (TUS) | TUS / KTUS |
| 田納西州 | Nashville International Airport (BNA) | BNA / KBNA |

這些機場在美國境內外航線網絡中扮演關鍵角色，承載大量國際、跨洲及國內航班。若您需要更詳細的資訊，例如航站樓數量、年旅客吞吐量或主要航空公司，我可以再提供！
message.reasoning: User asks: "請告訴我美國的一些主要機場。" They want major airports in the US. We can provide list. No tool needed.
